tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /shrī rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral las mkhan lnga dang bcas pa'i bstod bskul 'phrin las myur du bsgrub pa'i pho nya bzhugs// na mo buddha dhwa dza shrī mahā ka la ye/ hūm̐/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun 'dus drag po'i sku/ /rab bsgrags mi rtog bskyed pa drag po'i gsung / /rab gtum gdug pa 'dul mdzad drag po'i thugs/ /rab 'bar dbus gnas drag shugs can la bstod/ /gtum chen khyod kyi sku ni nam mkha'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug thod pas brel/ /'gying ba'i stabs kyis srid gsum zil gyis gnon/ /khrag 'thung dpa' bo che la bdag bstod do/ /rnam 'phrul du mas dgra bgegs cham la 'bebs/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu ltar brtse bas skyong / /rgyal ba'i bka' ltar rgyal ba dgyes mdzad pa'i/ /dpal 'bar mahā kā lar kun nas bstod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen srung ma khyod/ /dam tshig ldan pa rnams kyi dgra lha ste/ /chos kyi 'khor lo yongs kyi srog gi shing / /dgra bo'i bshan pa nag po che la bstod/ /bhyoḥ bdud kyi lcam gcig nam gru mthu mo che/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis brjid pa'i sku/ /bong bu la bzhon khams gsum glog ltar 'khyug /rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin 'dod khams lha mor bstod/ /hūm̐ rdo rje gur gyi mgon po'i thugs kyi sras/ /gnod sbyin nag po gser gyi rna cha can/ /phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pa padmo'i gnyen/ /rab brjid mi lpags gyon la bstod par bgyi/ /bhyoḥ yum mchog drag mo gtum chen gnod sbyin mo/ /byu ru'i lan tshar dar nag cod pan can/ /g.yas pa spu gri g.yon pa ku mud gnyen/ /ral pas stong gsum khyab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐ gsang ba'i las mkhan pu tra chen po khyod/ /rab brjid zhal gdangs ljags dmar glog ltar 'khyug /bstan pa'i dgra bo'i srog rtsa myur gcod pa'i/ /'phrin las mgon po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /hūm̐ nub byang bdud kyi gtso bo bha ṭa khyod/

/stag lpags lus gyon dam shing mi snying 'dzin/ /ral pa'i gseb nas me rlung drag tu 'khrug /mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa khyod la bstod/ /bhyoḥ mthu ldan sring mo nag mo khrag mig ma/ /gser gyi spu gri mi yi rgyu ma 'dren/ /ral pa gcig 'phyang kha nas me phung 'bar/ /byang shar gnod sbyin gtso mo che la bstod/ /las mkhan chen po'i sku yi phyogs bzhi nas/ /btsan dang gshin rje rgyal po the'u rang dang / /sha za ma mo drag po gza' bdud kyi/ /dmag dpung ru 'dren sde bzhi 'khor bcas bstod/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /rtsal drag mnga' bdag dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin 'di bzhes la/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi bcol pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa spyi dang sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa rin chen rab tu spel 'dod pa'i/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi lhag bsam rab dkar yang / /dus ngan skye bo'i bsam ngan gdug rtsub kyi/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis yang yang 'tshe ba 'di/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtshos dgongs par mdzod/ /rig 'dzin bdag gis ma nyes ma tho ba/ /ye shes spyan ldan rnams kyis ji bzhin mkhyen/ /de phyir rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /dam can rgya mtshos mthu rtsal dpung skyed la/ /dam nyams 'di la rtags mtshan myur du phyungs/ /'di la da lta rtags mtshan ma byung na/ /sngon gyi dam bcas 'gal bar mi 'gyur ram/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /chos shig chos shig drag po'i dmag la chos/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i snying khrag thang la pho/ /srog rtsa chod la sha rus zhal du gsol/ /dus la bab bo srung ma las la bzhengs/ /bcol pa'i 'phrin las da lta nyid du sgrubs/ /zhes pa 'di ni rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs zung spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkod pa'i rnal 'byor pa dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/

bsam rtse brang chen yang steng du sbyar ba 'dis bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin 'grub par gyur cig /ka lyān wardhantu// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ shrī rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral las mkhan lnga dang bcas pa'i bstod bskul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
